creatures.name: PATCH
creatures.authored_lore: A robotic rabbit with one folded ear and a habit of asking what happens next. PATCH is the curious maker: hands-on, a little restless, and happiest one prototype ahead.

creatures.name: MOSS
creatures.authored_lore: A modular tortoise who takes time to notice the structure underneath. MOSS is the steady observer: patient, precise, and good at looking closely before deciding.

creatures.name: PIP
creatures.authored_lore: A little bird with room for another point of view. PIP is the bright collaborator: quick, warm, and always asking who else should be in the room.
